t5.text: On a desk, and the states every screen shares

n1.text: The figure never moves or animates. It sits in the same place in every step. Only the controls around it open and close.

n2.text: A figure far outside the usual range asks once, in plain words, before it is recorded. It is never silently refused.

n3.text: Nothing is lost on bad signal: the page says what happened and what to do, and never leaves a spinner.

n4.text: Opening a booking link books nothing. The person confirms on the next screen.

n5.text: More than one service on a phone: one notification, one screen, each service confirmed on its own line.

n6.text: The practitioner never shares a trail. The coordinator sees an estimate the person chose.
